name: terratwin_photo_labels_v1
purpose: Training table for the learned photo-to-Earth model: one row per image with its geometry, sensor state and the Earth tile it should resolve to.

columns.name: image_id
columns.rule: unique; filename stem of the source image

columns.name: source_body
columns.rule: solid-body targets only; gas-giant cloud imagery is out of scope

columns.name: sensor
columns.example: Mastcam-Z L; LROC NAC; PSMO Mars 2020 S-200; Sentinel-2 L2A

columns.name: is_raw_jpeg
columns.rule: true means gain/white-balance applied - blocks albedo reuse

columns.name: radiometric_albedo_mean
columns.rule: only if the image is radiometrically calibrated; else null

columns.name: sun_elev_deg
columns.rule: needed before any slope proxy is trusted

columns.name: gsd_m_per_px
columns.rule: ground sample distance of the photo, drives the scale harmonisation

columns.name: target_tile_id
columns.rule: the Earth tile the image should map to; must exist in terratwin_ml_ranked.csv

columns.name: pair_label
columns.rule: 1 same geomorphic class, 0 different class (contrastive pairs)

columns.name: split_block
columns.rule: 0.81 deg spatial block key of target_tile_id - never random rows

columns.name: split_region
columns.rule: province name; leave-region-out folds are built from this

columns.name: annotator_confidence
columns.rule: 0..1; drop rows below 0.6 from training, keep for evaluation

validation_rules: target_tile_id must join to the ranked tile table (7,180 Earth tiles)
radiometric_albedo_mean may be null only when is_raw_jpeg is true
images from a province held out for evaluation must not appear in training
no image may contribute more than 5% of one archetype class
gsd_m_per_px within 2 orders of magnitude of the tile geometry, else resample first
each split_block appears in exactly one fold
honest_evaluation: primary metric: leave-region-out top-1/top-5 archetype accuracy and median rank of the true tile, never in-region accuracy
report a domain-classifier AUC between photo features and Earth tile features; if it stays above ~0.9 the match is still sensor-bound and must be labelled so
report band width (lat/lon km) of the top-5 neighbours as the uncertainty measure
note: This schema is the contract the site's browser matcher will be replaced by. The current photo panel uses only features a single uncalibrated photograph can provide, and labels them as structural proxies.
